findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: company_jobs, email_check, email_domain_auth, links_verify, open_media_search, subtitle_tools, url_markdown · Private data: company_jobs, file_convert, subtitle_tools, text_diff, text_stats, capture_url · Public sink: email_check, email_domain_auth, file_convert, subtitle_tools, text_stats · Destructive: dev_utils, file_convert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: company_jobs, email_check, email_domain_auth, links_verify, open_media_search, subtitle_tools, url_markdown · Private data: company_jobs, file_convert, subtitle_tools, text_diff, text_stats, capture_url · Public sink: email_check, email_domain_auth, file_convert, subtitle_tools, text_stats · Destructive: dev_utils, file_convert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
